artworks.prompt: A thin waxing crescent moon, cool silver-white, crisp lunar surface detail on the lit limb, like a long-lens night photograph. ONLY the bright lit crescent is visible: the dark part of the moon is completely invisible, exactly the same colour as the background (NO earthshine, no grey disc, no outline). Nothing else: no stars, no glow halo, no aurora.

Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a common raven in flight at night, wings spread wide, glossy black feathers picking up a faint cool green sheen from the aurora off-frame and pale moonlight from the upper left.

A single real snowflake (stellar dendrite) photographed macro against the night, matte white crystal with fine natural branches, very faintly lit cool blue-green, slightly soft focus at the tips. Not glassy, not glowing, not an icon.

The Pleiades star cluster as seen in a real long-lens astrophotograph: a compact group of seven bright blue-white stars with soft natural glow and short faint diffraction, a few fainter stars around them, filling about 55% of the frame. No nebula clouds, no aurora, no landscape.
